title: Restore CKC story panels and native moodboard integration
operator_request: CKC gained story per character and a moodboard; the old Excalidraw attempt should be replaced by the already-built Handshake notion-style moodboard system.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Reuse current Handshake moodboard/canvas/notion-style primitives; do not revive Excalidraw unless explicitly approved.

scope.summary: Give CKC character sheets linked story and moodboard surfaces using native Handshake primitives.
base_scope: Add or wire story documents per character/sheet version.
Add moodboard links/cards per character using existing native moodboard/canvas primitives.
Keep story, character sheet notes, image notes, and moodboards distinct but cross-linked.
Expose story and moodboard tabs/panels inside CKC when appropriate.
Update internal UserManual with story and moodboard workflows.
acceptance_criteria: A CKC character can open linked story content.
A CKC character can open linked moodboard content through native Handshake primitives.
Story/moodboard refs persist and can be reused by other modules.
Argus can inspect and steer story/moodboard entry points.
verification: Backend/ref tests for story and moodboard links.
Native UI tests for CKC story/moodboard surfaces.

validation_v1.fail_report: MT-012's implementation is committed (776c4a47/fb6ecf39) and its four acceptance criteria are present in committed source, BUT its only committed managed-PostgreSQL proof (story/moodboard round-trip + MOODBOARD_SNAPSHOT_RECORDED EventLedger) lives in tests/atelier_core_data_tests.rs, which FAILS TO COMPILE at committed HEAD: rustc E0382 borrow-after-move (metadata_request_id moved into IntakeClassificationMetadata at :1999, then borrowed at .bind(...) :2054). Verified by cargo test --no-run at HEAD (the file is committed-clean, so the defect is in the committed blob). A non-compiling test binary runs zero assertions, so the AC3 persistence claim's managed-resource proof (SR2) is not established. This is why MT-045 exists (isolate this proof from the broken binary).
validation_v1.remediation_plan: 1) Fix tests/atelier_core_data_tests.rs:1999 -> request_id: Some(metadata_request_id.clone()). 2) Confirm cargo test --no-run --test atelier_core_data_tests succeeds. 3) Run the MT-012 story/moodboard round-trip + MOODBOARD_SNAPSHOT_RECORDED tests against managed PostgreSQL (or land MT-045 first, which moves the moodboard proof into a clean isolated test binary) and record the passing output. 4) Re-submit for validation.

validation_v2.runtime_reexec: LIVE_REEXEC_ENV_BLOCKED: independent live run attempted; the shared test harness auto-start of Handshake-managed PostgreSQL FAILED at pg_ctl ("could not create any TCP/IP sockets"; port 5544 already held by an existing managed cluster / 46 postgres procs, likely a concurrent session). All PG tests panicked at atelier_pg_support.rs:35 (ensure_running error arm) BEFORE any assertion - which independently confirms the proof is a REAL managed-PG test (non-mock/non-skip; a fake would pass vacuously) and that NO MT test panicked at its own logic. Not run against the concurrent cluster to avoid disrupting an active session (data-loss/no-disruption rule). Backend proof binary COMPILES (compile-gate PASS, exit 0). Verdict basis: committed-presence-at-HEAD + backend compile-gate PASS + 5-agent adversarial committed-source review + coder's recorded managed-PG non-SKIP passes on this same cluster. Consistent with V1 (runtime_reexec then = ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED_HOST_OOM).
validation_v2.spec_realism_gate: SR1 clean (no deferred-live escape reachable from proof); SR2 satisfied (real Handshake-managed PostgreSQL/EventLedger/ArtifactStore or, for frontend, real egui/AccessKit/Argus harness); SR3 clean (remediated_by KERNEL_BUILDER != validator).
